d: quote_suc is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.quote_suc.short: Quotation passes through successor: if f x = y then f (suc x) = suc y, for f preserving successor

d: alt_Build_MaybeAlgebra_Morphism is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.alt_Build_.short: A function with f 0 = 0 and f (suc x) = suc (f x) for all x preserves zero and successor

d: id_maybe_algebra_morphism is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.id_maybe_a.short: The identity function preserves zero and successor

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.compose_ma.short: The composite of two maps preserving zero and successor preserves them

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.invert_may.short: The inverse of a bijection preserving zero and successor preserves them

d: nno_initial_alt is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_initia.short: Two maps out of a natural numbers object that preserve zero and successor are equal

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_to_nno.short: The canonical map between two natural numbers objects is a bijection, its inverse the canonical map back

d: nno_suc_inj is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_suc_in.short: The successor of a natural numbers object is injective

d: nno_suc_nonzero is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_suc_no.short: In a natural numbers object, suc n ≠ 0 for every n

d: nno_dec_eq is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_dec_eq.short: A natural numbers object has decidable equality

d: nno_zero_or_suc is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_zero_o.short: Every n of a natural numbers object is 0 or the successor of some m

d: nno_ind is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_ind.short: Affine induction: if P n implies P (suc n) for every n, then P 0 implies P n for all n

d: nno_ind_alt is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_ind_al.short: Induction for an extensional family of affine propositions, with base case and step given in the base logic

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.ϕ.short: The iteration n ↦ fⁿ(x): the canonical map from ℕ to X with x as zero and f as successor

d: nno_rec_is_fun is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_rec_is.short: The iteration of f from x depends on x extensionally: equal starting points give equal iterations

d: nno_rec is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_rec.short: Primitive recursion: the function X × ℕ ⇾ X sending (x, n) to f applied n times to x

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_rec_ba.short: The base equation of recursion: nno_rec f (x, 0) = x

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_rec_st.short: The step equation of recursion: nno_rec f (x, suc n) = f (nno_rec f (x, n))

d: nno_rec_strong_is_fun is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_rec_st.short: For strong X, recursion is extensional in f: equal functions give equal recursions

d: nno_rec_fun is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_rec_fu.short: Primitive recursion (X ⇾ X) ⇾ (X × ℕ ⇾ X) as a function of sets, for strong X
The base equation for the bundled recursion: nno_rec_fun f (x, 0) = x
The step equation for the bundled recursion: nno_rec_fun f (x, suc n) = f (nno_rec f (x, n))

AffineConstructive.theory.nno.nno_induct.short: Begins a proof by induction over a natural numbers object, leaving the base case and the step
